Both numbered frames are broken renders. The spec calls for a deep, refined starfield of 1200 tiny instanced points with depth falloff and a controlled emissive red core with additive-glow discipline. Instead both frames are dominated by a massive blown-out white smear, a flat red bar, and a stray dark rectangle patch — the actual particles are just sparse scattered specks overwhelmed by broken elements.
